_note: Half-wave folded dipole for the VHF band (balanced, two leads a, b). Engine (bw-board dipole): EMF = field x heightM (0.95 m, lambda/pi at 100 MHz) x cos(turn - station bearing) behind ohms (300 Ohm folded) between a and b; the turn is a knob (0..1 = 0..360 degrees): a two-sided figure-eight. No earth needed.
